title: Valerie L NDE 4043
content: I was a stewardess at the time. I flew a lot and I was tired. I caught a white angina bacterium that wasn't easily cured. The streptococcus got to my heart valves causing valve damaged. I was transported in emergency to a suburb hospital. They did not see that my valve was damaged. After twelve hours, I was eventually transferred to a hospital in Paris. Upon arrival, I felt myself fade away. I don't remember anything except waking up in a room. Then I was transferred to another hospital because I was in critical condition. This is when I had my experience. I don't know the exact date. I first saw myself as some sort of big smoke - it was me but not in my body. I tried to see my arms, my legs, nothing. I could only see myself as smoke. I turned around in some sort of concrete swimming pool, and I was not alone there. Somebody else turned around with me. I did not talk to him, I did not even try to, and we turned around clockwise. I don't know how I came back into my body. (Later I was told that I was in the intensive care unit and the person in the room next to mine was in a coma, maybe that was him. I don't know). After that, or around the same time (I can't measure time during this period) I heard a very stressful noise next to me, it was the machine connected to my heart and I opened my eyes. The ceiling turned into a very bulgy cloud, and I climbed into it. There I felt fine but I knew there was something wrong. All of a sudden, somebody appeared in front of me. He was young with a beard. I told him, 'When do I go back down to earth?' He said, 'But you are already on earth.' I did not believe him. I asked the same question again, he replied the same answer and I got back down into my body. Then, and again, much after or after or before, I don't know. I found myself in a tunnel, but this tunnel was half-full of water, there was a light in the end, the water brought me there and indeed, I did not want to go. I don't know why I thought that, I saw some kind of opening on my left, I would say another tunnel, but on my left I heard my dog barking, calling me. Effortlessly I went to my left and I exited the tunnel. I was stranded on some sort of embankment, my dog was there, and after that I don't remember.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Experienced self as "some sort of big smoke" (not in body) in "some sort of concrete swimming pool"; later perceived ceiling turning into a "very bulgy cloud" and "climbed into it."

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Tunnel was "half-full of water" and "the water brought me there."

arrival.other_being_detail: A "young" man "with a beard" appeared and responded to her questions.

environment.environment_other_detail: Concrete "swimming pool"; ceiling became a "very bulgy cloud" that she climbed into; later an "embankment."

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Returned after dialogue with the bearded young man; also reports later opening eyes upon hearing the heart machine noise.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: White angina bacterium/streptococcus affecting heart valves; critical condition in ICU.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard dog barking/calling; exited via an opening to the left; found self on an embankment with the dog.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Sequence includes smoke-form OBE in a concrete pool, cloud/ceiling ascent with encounter and dialogue, return to body, then later tunnel half-full of water with light and side exit prompted by dog barking.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Narrator reports uncertainty about order and timing: "After that, or around the same time..." and "much after or after or before, I don't know."

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Self perceived as "big smoke"; concrete swimming pool setting; ceiling turning into a "very bulgy cloud" climbed into; tunnel half-full of water; dog barking/calling leading to side exit and embankment scene.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I first saw myself as some sort of big smoke - it was me but not in my body." "When do I go back down to earth?" "But you are already on earth." "I found myself in a tunnel, but this tunnel was half-full of water... the water brought me there... I did not want to go."
